authorId.description: authorId is the identifier of the author of the article.

body.description: body is the block-formatted content of this article.

bodyHtml.description: bodyHtml is the HTML-formatted content of this article.
bodyHtml.example: 채널톡을 처음 시작할 때 필요한 세팅 과정을 모두 알려드려요.

coverImageUrl.description: coverImageUrl is the URL of the cover image of the article.

createdAt.description: createdAt is the timestamp when the revision of the article in the requested language was created in epoch milliseconds.

currentRevisionId.description:
currentRevisionId is the identifier of the current revision of the article in the requested language.
An article could contain multiple revisions in a single language, but only one of them is considered as the "current" revision.
- If there is a published revision, the current revision is the published revision.
- If there are unpublished revisions, the current revision is the one with the latest updatedAt timestamp.
- If there are only draft revisions, the current revision is the one with the latest updatedAt timestamp.

id.description:
id is the unique identifier of the article.
However, an article has multiple revisions (versions) and there could be a published (a.k.a. live) version for each
language. (id, language) could work as a key for identifying a live content.

name.description: name is the name of the current revision of the article in the requested language.

publishedAt.description:
publishedAt is the timestamp when the article was published in epoch milliseconds.
This timestamp is only available when the article is published.
publishedAt could be updated when a new revision is published, but it can be configured manually by the user.

publishedRevisionId.description:
publishedRevisionId is the identifier of the published (live) revision of the article in the requested language.
If the article is not published, this field is empty.

slug.description: slug is the unique key of the article within the space, which can be used in the URL.

spaceId.description: spaceId is the unique identifier of the space that the article belongs to.

state.description:
state is the current state of the current revision of the article in the requested language.
- "draft": the article can be edited and is not visible to the public.
- "published": the article is visible to the public and cannot be edited.
- "unpublished": the article is not visible to the public and cannot be edited.

subtitle.description: subtitle is the subtitle of this article.
subtitle.example: 채널톡을 처음 시작할 때 필요한 세팅 과정을 모두 알려드려요.

summary.description: summary is the plaintext summary of this article.
summary.example: 채널톡을 처음 시작할 때 필요한 세팅 과정을 모두 알려드려요.

title.description: title is the title of this article.

topicIds.description: topicIds is the list of ids of the topics that the article is associated with.

updatedAt.description: updatedAt is the timestamp when the revision of the article in the requested language was last updated in epoch milliseconds.

website.description: website is metadata for the article's published website.

url.description: url is the URL of the article in the published website.

avatarUrl.description: avatarUrl is the URL for the author's profile image.

createdAt.description: createdAt is the timestamp when the author was created in epoch milliseconds.

id.description: id is the unique identifier of the author.

profile.description: profile is the map of localized profiles of the author.

spaceId.description: spaceId is the unique identifier of the space that the author belongs to.

updatedAt.description: updatedAt is the timestamp when the author was last updated in epoch milliseconds.

bio.description: bio is the short description of the author.
bio.example: Channel Talk is all-in-one live chat messenger for businesses.

name.description: name is the display name of the author.

coverImageUrl.description: coverImageUrl is the map of cover image URLs for each language.

createdAt.description: createdAt is the timestamp when the category was created in epoch milliseconds.

description.description: description is the map of localized descriptions of the category.

id.description: id is the unique identifier of the category.

name.description: name is the map of localized names of the category.

publishState.description: publishState is the setting whether the category is open to public for each language. "published" categories are open to public, while "unpublished" categories are not.

slug.description: slug is the unique key of the category within the space, which can be used in the URL.

spaceId.description: spaceId is the unique identifier of the space that the category belongs to.

updatedAt.description: updatedAt is the timestamp when the category was last updated in epoch milliseconds.

createdAt.description: createdAt is the timestamp when the navigation node was created in epoch milliseconds.

entityId.description:
entityId is the id of the entity that is connected to this node.
The root node does not have an entity connected to it.

entityType.description:
entityType is the type of the entity that is connected to this node.
The root node does not have an entity connected to it.
It can be one of the following:
- category: The entity is a category.
- article: The entity is an article.

id.description: id is the unique identifier of the navigation node.

nodeType.description:
nodeType is the type of the navigation node. It can be one of the following:
- root: The root node of the navigation tree. There is only one root node in a navigation tree.
- category: A category node in the navigation tree.
- article: An article node in the navigation tree.

parentNodeId.description:
parentNodeId is the id of the parent node of this node.
root node does not have a parent node.

rank.description: rank is the order of the node within the siblings in the navigation tree.

spaceId.description: spaceId is the unique identifier of the space that the navigation node belongs to.

updatedAt.description: updatedAt is the timestamp when the navigation node was last updated in epoch milliseconds.
